name: Signature Holo

components.pose: She stands still and regal on the dais with the staff raised in one hand and the other palm turned down over the frost spreading across the floor, her mantle lifted by a cold wind, a calm, absolute gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: Frost races outward across the floor and up the pillars, a storm of ice crystals and snow swirls around her in a slow spiral, a ring of floating ice shards orbits the staff, and the windows frost over in {{MAGIC}} light.

notes: HOLO edition 'Frost Sovereign': the Signature scene re-authored with an ascended pose, upgraded signature weapon, crown, mantle, grander magic and a closer dragon. Holo shader/foil is applied in the client, not baked in.
